seoTitle: Double Kick: Menu Translator for Travelers
metaDescription: Point your camera at any foreign menu and order with confidence. Translate dishes and drinks, see ingredients and flavor, and convert prices to your currency.
heroHeadline: Order exactly what you want, in any language
heroSubhead: Point your camera at a menu you can't read. Double Kick gives you the story behind every dish and drink: what's in it, how it's made, how it tastes, and the price in your own currency.
highlights: One photo reads the whole menu
Prices converted to your home currency
No ads, no tracking, history stays on your device

features.title: Photo to Full Menu
features.body: Snap one picture of a food or drinks menu and read every item translated, with ingredients, preparation, and flavor in plain language.

features.title: Flavor You Can See
features.body: Each dish and drink gets a flavor profile across sweet, sour, bitter, salty, and umami, so you know what's coming before it arrives.

features.title: Drinks Decoded
features.body: Understand spirits, cocktails, and wine lists that word-for-word translators skip. From mezcal to Brennivin, you get a real description.

features.title: Prices in Your Currency
features.body: Every price is converted to your home currency, so you can weigh what to order and what it actually costs.

features.title: Split and Tip
features.body: A built-in calculator splits the bill across the table and works out the tip in the currency you're paying in.

features.title: Your Taste, Remembered
features.body: Set your cuisines, spirits, flavors, and dietary needs like vegan or gluten-free once. Your menu history stays on your device.

howItWorks.body: Point your camera at any food or drinks menu and take one photo.
Get every item translated with ingredients, flavor, preparation, dietary flags, and the price in your currency.
Decide with confidence and order exactly what you want, no more guessing.

faq.q: How much does Double Kick cost?
faq.a: Double Kick is free to download and uses credit packs to scan menus. You buy credits once and spend them as you photograph menus. There is no subscription.

faq.q: Do I need an account to use it?
faq.a: No. You can start scanning menus right away with no account. Sign in with Apple is optional and only there to sync your credits across your devices.

faq.q: What happens to my menu history and data?
faq.a: Your menu history stays on your device. There are no ads, no tracking, and your data is not sold.

faq.q: What kinds of menus does it handle?
faq.a: Both food and drinks menus, from street stalls to fine-dining tasting menus. It reads dishes and decodes spirits, cocktails, and wine lists in any language.

faq.q: Does it convert prices to my currency?
faq.a: Yes. Prices on the menu are read and converted to your home currency, so you can decide with the real cost in front of you.
Reading a menu needs a network connection to analyze the photo. Your saved menu history and preferences stay on your device and are available without scanning again.

faq.q: Can I set my dietary needs and taste?
faq.a: Yes. You can choose preferred cuisines, spirits, flavor intensities, and dietary restrictions such as vegan or gluten-free, and Double Kick keeps those in mind.
Double Kick runs on iPhone with iOS 17 or later.
